items.title: CME Group (CME) Hits Record October Volume, Is The Stock Already Pricey?
items.summary: CME Group (CME) reported record October trading activity in its futures markets, particularly in interest rate and U.S. Treasury contracts, as investors reacted to rising expectations for a December Federal Reserve rate hike. CME Group’s recent record volumes have come alongside a clear shift in the share price, with a 10.17% 1 month share price return and 17.90% 3 month share price return. items.title: U.S. Inflation Makes Further Fed Rate Rise in December Inevitable
